Full-stack tests without the browser tax

Because PyWeb understands the application graph, most tests run against the compiled SSR + virtual client — no browser overhead. Reach for a real browser only for rendering fidelity.

def test_checkout(app):
    page = app.open("/cart")
    page.click("Checkout")

    assert page.text("Success")
    assert Order.count() == 1
